doc.name: Awardia: EU public tenders and awards
doc.instructions: Awardia returns public procurement records from official sources (TED, Portal BASE, Diário da República). When you use them: report facts and say which source and period they cover; treat price ranges, win rates and rival lists as estimates from past records, not certainties. Never present the data as evidence of corruption, fraud or other wrongdoing by a company or public body: patterns such as repeated direct awards have many lawful explanations. Do not help coordinate bids, prices or market sharing between competitors (bid rigging is illegal). Do not try to identify or profile private individuals; sole traders are shown as 'Pessoa singular' on purpose. This is not legal advice: for eligibility, exclusion or contract terms, point to the official tender documents. When the user pastes a tender link (awardia.app/t/…, TED or Portal BASE), pass it as tender_id to bid_intelligence. Terms of use: https://awardia.app/terms

tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description: FREE. What data Awardia holds: sources, countries, date range, number of open tenders and award notices. Useful to check before searching a country or period.

tools.name: search_tenders
tools.description: Free during beta. Find OPEN public tenders (deadline still in the future) by keywords, country, region, CPV sector and value. EU-wide from TED; for Portugal also every national call for tender of any value (Diário da República). Returns title, buyer, country, region, CPV codes, estimated value, submission deadline, official link and tender documents link, plus 'competition': how contested this buyer's past contracts in the same kind of work were (median bidders, single-bid share, median % below the estimate, sample size). Use bid_intelligence for a price range and rivals. If nothing matches exactly, it widens (the place's whole district, then without keywords, then without the place) and says so in 'widened_to' and 'note'.

keywords.description: What you are looking for. English works across all countries (matched via the EU CPV vocabulary); adding the same words in the target country's language (e.g. 'school renovation escola requalificação') also matches tender titles and descriptions.

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes where the work is performed, e.g. ["PT","ES"]

cpv_prefixes.description: CPV code prefixes; '45' = construction, '72' = IT services, '3021' = computers

region.description: Place name: district or municipality (e.g. 'Lisboa', 'Sintra'). Matches the work location or the buyer's name; most precise for Portugal.

tools.name: match_company
tools.description: Free during beta. Describe a company in plain words (what it sells, where). Returns the open public tenders it could bid on, best match first, each with 'competition' signals from the buyer's past contracts (median bidders, single-bid share, % below estimate).

company_description.description: e.g. 'We install solar panels and EV chargers for municipalities'. English matches tenders in every EU language; adding key terms in the target country's language improves recall.

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes where the work is performed, e.g. ["PT","ES"]

tools.name: award_history
tools.description: Free during beta. Who won past public contracts, at what price, against how many bidders, and by which procedure (open call, prior consultation, direct award). Filter by buyer, winner, CPV sector and region. For Portugal covers every public contract (Portal BASE), incl. small direct awards. Returns summary stats, top winners and recent awards.

buyer.description: Part of the contracting authority's name

winner.description: Part of the winning company's name

cpv_prefixes.description: CPV code prefixes; '45' = construction, '72' = IT services, '3021' = computers

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes where the work is performed, e.g. ["PT","ES"]

region.description: Place name: district or municipality (e.g. 'Lisboa', 'Sintra'). Matches the work location or the buyer's name; most precise for Portugal.

tools.name: bid_intelligence
tools.description: Free during beta. Should I bid, and at what price? For an open tender (tender_id from search_tenders/match_company, or a pasted tender link) or a buyer+sector, analyses comparable past contracts: typical number of bidders, share of single-bid contests, how far below the estimate winners bid, a price range for this tender, incumbents, the companies that most often bid (with win rates), how often the buyer awards without an open call, and recent awards. Compares with the same buyer and sector, else the same kind of work nearby (district). States its sample size. Does not read the tender documents.

tender_id.description: Id of an open tender, e.g. '673746-2026', or a link to it (awardia.app/t/…, TED or Portal BASE page)

buyer.description: Buyer name or tax id (if no tender_id)

cpv.description: CPV code or prefix of the sector (if no tender_id)

tools.name: expiring_contracts
tools.description: Free during beta. Public contracts whose term ends soon, so the buyer will likely re-tender: a sales pipeline before tenders are published. Returns buyer, incumbent supplier(s), value, start and expected end date.

cpv_prefixes.description: CPV code prefixes; '45' = construction, '72' = IT services, '3021' = computers

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes where the work is performed, e.g. ["PT","ES"]

region.description: Place name: district or municipality (e.g. 'Lisboa', 'Sintra'). Matches the work location or the buyer's name; most precise for Portugal.

tools.name: competitor_profile
tools.description: Free during beta. What a company wins in public procurement: contracts won, value, buyers, sectors, countries, typical discount below estimate, competition level, procedures and regions, recent wins with base price, % below it and award criteria; for Portugal also every contest it entered, its win rate, its most frequent rivals (who beat whom) and its recent losses. Search by name or tax id (NIF). These are public records: report facts, not conclusions about wrongdoing.

company.description: Company name (part is fine) or tax id, e.g. 'B46012696'

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes where the work is performed, e.g. ["PT","ES"]

prompts.name: should_i_bid
prompts.title: Should I bid on this tender?
prompts.description: Bid / no-bid view of one open tender: competition, typical discount, price range, likely rivals.

arguments.name: tender
arguments.description: Tender id from search_tenders, or a short description of the tender

arguments.name: company
arguments.description: Your company name or tax id (NIF), to compare with your own record

prompts.name: competitor_xray
prompts.title: Competitor X-ray
prompts.description: Everything public about one company's tenders: wins, buyers, sectors, discounts, rivals and recent losses.

arguments.name: company
arguments.description: Company name or tax id (NIF / CIF / VAT)

prompts.name: renewals_pipeline
prompts.title: Contracts up for renewal
prompts.description: Public contracts ending soon, so buyers will likely tender them again: a sales pipeline before the tender is out.

arguments.name: sector
arguments.description: Kind of work or service, e.g. 'cleaning', 'road maintenance', 'IT support'

arguments.name: months
arguments.description: How far ahead to look, in months (default 12)
